title: Phytophthora infestans (late blight) — EPPO
body: EPPO taxon PHYTIN: Phytophthora infestans causes late blight of potato and tomato. Cool moist conditions favour rapid spread. Typical signs include water-soaked lesions and white sporulation on leaf undersides. Cultural sanitation and registered fungicides per official labels are key. title: Myzus persicae (green peach aphid) — EPPO
body: EPPO taxon MYSYPE: Myzus persicae is a polyphagous aphid and important virus vector. Monitor colonies on growing tips; favour biological control and selective insecticides only when thresholds are exceeded and products are registered for the crop.
